svg.title: Effective restricted DG charts from Betti and Koszul models
svg.desc: A local Euclidean three-disc good-cover model has nonempty triple intersection and filled triangular nerve. The complete finite good cover of the compact curve gives its finite pointed homotopy model. Full derived local systems give an affine framed Betti ambient. Finite evaluations express every SCI coefficient coordinate as a polynomial word coordinate, proving closedness. Explicit odd Koszul generators and uniform nilpotence retain all DG nullhomotopies. The filtered infinity-category of such stages represents the full restricted functor. The final example has a homotopy-nilpotent element t with t squared equal ds, and a uniform two-step chain homotopy in infinitely many coefficient degrees.
svg.text: Effective restricted DG charts from Betti and Koszul models
Complex projective connected X, chosen x, connected reductive H; every connective DG coefficient.
1. A finite good cover retains the entire homotopy type — RBC.1–RBC.5
U₁
U₂
U₃
U₁₂₃ ≠ ∅
nerve
filled 2-simplex
Barycentric weights: φ₁+φ₂+φ₃=1
The three open discs give a local model; the complete cover gives Xᵃⁿ ← T → |N| ≃ K.
Barycentric weights prove the first equivalence; contractible cell attachments prove the second.
2. Full tensor reconstruction gives an actual affine Betti ambient — RBC.6–RBC.10
I_X ↪ Fun(K,Mod_ℂ); internal A-actions and every tensor path are retained.
Start with H^m on the one-skeleton; attach a d-cell by V ×_(Ω^(d−2)H) Spec ℂ.
Y_B=Spec B; the whole nilpotent lift space of the restricted ind-image is unchanged.
A restricted DG point is detected by its ordinary reduction, with all negative directions present.
3. Finite coefficient evaluations prove a closed coordinate map — RBC.11–RBC.13
R=H⁰(B); Y_E=Spec S_E; q_i ↦ Σ_α e_α x_(iα).
Choose finitely many group words whose evaluations distinguish the finite coalgebra E.
A linear left inverse recovers x_(iα)=Σ_w c_(αw) q_i(ρ(γ_w)).
Each word evaluation is a regular polynomial in the generator matrices and their inverses.
R → S_E is surjective on the actual coordinate rings, including all ordinary nilpotents.
4. Actual odd Koszul generators give full unbounded completions — RBC.14–RBC.19
B_(E,N)=B[η₁,…,η_r]; |η_i|=−1; dη_i=f_i^N.
N′≥N: η_i at stage N′ maps to f_i^(N′−N)η_i at stage N.
At B→A the fibre consists of nullhomotopies; differences form (Ω∞A[−1])^r.
If f_i^n₀=0 in H⁰(A), the same gap N′−N≥n₀ kills differences in every degree.
The fibre colimit is contractible precisely over the full formal-completion points.
5. Coherent finite diagrams have affine closed cones — RBC.20–RBC.25
Take the full infinity-category of these affine stages over Y_B.
A common larger E′ and the contractible completion fibres give every finite coherent cone.
Every map induces a quotient on H⁰; all transitions are derived closed immersions.
Y_restr=colim_T T on every DG algebra; Z_restr=[Y_restr/H] is the actual frame quotient.
The affine stages have finite derived presentation and cotangent Tor amplitude [−1,0].
6. A uniform chain homotopy in infinitely many layers — RBC.37–RBC.40
t is not strictly nilpotent; H*(A)=ℂ[t]/t² ⊗ ℂ[z] ⊗ Λ(θ).
For N≥2: η_N ↦ t^(N−2)s gives compatible actual nullhomotopies of t^N.
One-step multiplication by t is nonzero in every layer; two steps give d m_s + m_s d=m_t².
All stage fibres have higher groups; their filtered colimit is one point.
Examples: P¹ and elliptic G_m charts; surplus stage homotopies; variable and unipotent families; exact N=3.
Restricted localization, Hecke action, nilpotent support image and original-field regularity are additional.
Proof locators: §§3.136–3.150. Ind-scheme framework: AGKRRV, arXiv:2010.01906v2.
